title: ExternalAuthorizationRecord
description: The school and research-ethics decision that admits real students. Engineering supplies the format and the validator and cannot self-issue the decision. Every dimension of the scope is named here explicitly - the rooms are listed, the cohort is counted, the window is closed at both ends, the surfaces are enumerated - so widening the pilot needs a new signed decision rather than a wider reading of this one.

synthetic.description: A synthetic record is a rehearsal of the paperwork and is not an authorization. True is refused.

authorizingBody.description: Who decided. The body is carried as a salted digest of its identity, never the identity itself.

scope.description: What was authorized. There is no wildcard and no open end: a room not listed here was not authorized.

maxStudentsTotal.description: The largest number of distinct students the body admitted across every authorized room.

supervisingTeacherRef.description: The named teacher who supervises the authorized sessions, as a salted digest.

rollbackOwnerRef.description: Who may stop the pilot, as a salted digest.

participantInformation.description: How participants and their guardians were informed, and by when consent was held. Sessions may not begin before that date.

reviewedDocuments.description: The documents the body actually reviewed, bound by digest. Exactly one entry per required kind: a decision taken over a document version nobody can name is not reviewable later.

retentionPolicyId.description: The pilot retention policy version these sessions run under.

providerScope.description: The exact model provider the decision covers. `no_persistent_copy_attested` must name the signed copy-authority record and its expiry; `delete_and_probe` must name the reviewed capability and port schema versions. Neither may name the other's fields, and no URL, endpoint or secret appears here.

featureAllowlist.description: The surfaces this decision opens. Student-visible ECHO and TRACE are deliberately absent from the vocabulary: showing students the analytics built from their own conversation is a separate signed decision, and cannot be reached from here.

usedForGradesOrDiscipline.description: Whether the analytics feed grades or discipline. True is refused; the pilot makes no claim about an individual student.

authorizedSignerRefs.description: Who may sign for the body, as salted digests. Naming a signer is not itself proof - the envelope signature is.
